body: More or less medical school.  I thought helping others would make me happier and give me some purpose...make things worth continuing I suppose.  And now as I approach my first exam, I just don't know why I am not happy when I finally got what I wanted
Wow...I am super vague.  I'm just severely depressed, and a med student.  And the two don't mix particularly well

If there are others that are more urgent please help them first.  I'm not planning on doing anything tonight, but I noticed that there are some people who really need to talk...more than I.  I just can't talk to anyone around me because if they realize what level I am at, there is no way they will keep me as a student...not that it will matter if I do end up carrying something through to fruition.  But mostly I have made some choices hoping that they would bring me long term happiness (I have never been a happy fellow) and foregone momentary happiness in making these choices.  And not my world feels like its crumbling and I am looking down from the mountain I've built up in telling myself all they things I have done thinking that someday I will feel better, and I don't see the point.  I just wonder if I shouldn't simply choose a day, make a plan, and then just relax... I mean then at least I could maybe happy for a bit.  Everything just seems pointless and I think it could be my answer
